description: The diagram, titled "Diagram 39 Shielding of appliances", depicts a central square containing a diagonal cross, with the label "Appliance" positioned above it. This appliance is shown in relation to two different installation scenarios on either side. On the left, labeled "(a) Without shield", a vertical line represents "Combustible material". The gap between this line and the appliance is marked with a dimension indicating "Air space at least 75mm". On the right, labeled "(b) With shield", a thick vertical line is labeled "Non-combustible material" below it. A dimension between the appliance and this vertical line indicates "Shield at least 25mm". To the right of this shield, a separate vertical line is labeled "Combustible material".
